info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Channel Specific By Param1-spec
info.description: The Channel Specific Management API enables businesses to efficiently update the contact center management details for specific channels. By utilizing this endpoint, organizations can modify configurations based on unique parameters, allowing for tailored interactions with each channel. This API is ideal for customer service teams and developers looking to enhance communication strategies and provide personalized experiences. Typical use cases include adjusting service parameters to improve response strategies and adapting to evolving customer needs.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the specific details of the Contact Center Management resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the correct fields are included in your request to successfully apply the updates.

requestBody.description: Updates the contact center management settings for the specified resource, allowing for modifications to be made to its properties. This operation requires the appropriate permissions and expects a JSON body containing the new values for the specified fields.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the resource has been updated.
